column1: # The function of a file or a declaration, where the source names none, decided by reading it (rewrite.py --fn-map): `FILE F`, `FILE@decl F`, `tie T F`; `F` a function, a family `f__L`, `f__L_loop0`, or functions `f,g` one template serves; `align NAME F`: positions in the list `NAME` are `F`'s body's.

# B1/Gkr: the layer's templates GlT.glBody assembles before its renamed tail (checked by glIs_layers), the loop's (glIs_loops), verify_bus_gkr_loop0's body (l8Check), the layers' and last layers' bodies (GlCLayers)
# Opening: the loop's parameters and guard, the main function's frame (every specialization names them alike)
# Digest: each function's own declarations; the generic frame and loop walks (anyOk, grpOk, monoOk, loop steps) stay parametric; a proof over every `*_last__L{k}` by its family
# Selectors: each specialization family by its file
# Place: the level functions' proofs over their families
# Whir: the level functions' templates over their families

# B1/Tables: verify_tables' chunks (Vt/Base: core% «verify_tables» c0 ..), its body read by position and flattened (vtPre, vtAt, vtEvL), the generated slice templates checked against the chunks (Vt/*T, VtC/FData, FWin, ZBase, ZSetup, ZTail), the call statements of its body (VtC/ARelIn); its loop's, shared_selector_tables' and padding_weight's bodies
# B1/Tables files about verify_tables' body and its valuations throughout (each header read), for the declarations that name no template
# B1/Sig: the xmss segment's pops (each declaration about main_loop2's segment)

# files about one function's own numbering throughout (each header read), for the declarations that name no template; left out: canonically renumbered (Gkr Root, VbgOdd, GlTail, GlCTail, GlCLoop), mixed (GlCIn, GlCInLs, Holds, PackComplete*, PackLoop, CopyLoopIn), generic (Codeword*, Xmss{T,Layer,Core,Step}: verify_lean_xmss' own template)
# lists whose positions are a body's
# B1/Gkr: the layer's tail in the canonical numbering (`glRho 0 0`, `gkr_layer__L0_L0`'s), and the templates and lemmas at `p = 0` named by it
# Read per declaration (review round m29): templates and valuations of one function, family or set of loops
